name: Bench press
notes: Lie on a flat bench, lower the bar to the mid chest with the elbows tucked slightly, then press it back up.

name: Incline bench press
notes: Barbell press on a bench set to a moderate incline, bar touching the upper chest.

name: Decline bench press
notes: Barbell press on a decline bench, bar lowering to the lower chest.

name: Dumbbell bench press
notes: Flat-bench press with a dumbbell in each hand, allowing a deeper stretch than a bar.

name: Incline dumbbell press
notes: Dumbbell press on an inclined bench, working the upper chest through a full range.

name: Decline dumbbell press
notes: Dumbbell press on a decline bench, aimed at the lower chest.

name: Smith machine bench press
notes: Flat bench press on a fixed bar path, useful for training close to failure with less balance demand.

name: Smith machine incline press
notes: Incline press on the Smith machine with the bench set at a moderate angle.

name: Machine chest press
notes: Seated press on a chest press machine with a guided path.

name: Dumbbell fly
notes: On a flat bench, open the arms wide with soft elbows and bring the dumbbells together over the chest.

name: Incline dumbbell fly
notes: Fly movement on an inclined bench to emphasise the upper chest.

name: Cable crossover
notes: Standing between high pulleys, sweep the handles down and together in front of the body.

name: Low-to-high cable fly
notes: Pulleys set low; raise the handles in an arc up to chest height to target the upper chest.

name: High-to-low cable fly
notes: Pulleys set high; bring the handles down and across toward the hips to target the lower chest.

name: Pec deck fly
notes: Seated machine fly, pressing the pads together in front of the chest.

name: Push-ups
notes: From a straight-body plank position, lower the chest to the floor and press back up.

name: Decline push-ups
notes: Push-up with the feet raised on a bench, shifting load toward the upper chest and shoulders.

name: Chest dips
notes: On parallel bars, lean the torso forward and lower until the shoulders are below the elbows, then press up.
uncertain_note: Chest vs triceps emphasis depends on torso lean.

name: Resistance band chest press
notes: Press a band forward from the chest while standing or lying, with the band anchored behind you.

name: Pull-ups
notes: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip and pull the chest toward it, then lower under control.

name: Chin-ups
notes: Pull-up with an underhand, shoulder-width grip, which brings the biceps in more.

name: Neutral-grip pull-ups
notes: Pull-up with palms facing each other on parallel handles.

name: Assisted pull-ups
notes: Pull-up on a machine that offsets part of your body weight with a counterweight.

name: Lat pulldown
notes: Seated, pull the bar to the upper chest while keeping the chest up and elbows moving down.

name: Close-grip lat pulldown
notes: Pulldown with a narrow neutral handle, keeping the elbows close to the sides.

name: Underhand lat pulldown
notes: Pulldown with a shoulder-width underhand grip.

name: Straight-arm pulldown
notes: Standing at a high cable, sweep the bar from overhead to the thighs with nearly straight arms.

name: Barbell row
notes: Hinged forward with a flat back, pull the bar to the lower ribs and lower it under control.

name: Pendlay row
notes: Barbell row from the floor each rep with the torso parallel to the ground, pulled explosively to the chest.
uncertain_note: Upper-back emphasis; lats vs mid-back as primary is a judgement call.

name: Underhand barbell row
notes: Barbell row with a supinated grip, pulling toward the waist.

name: T-bar row
notes: Straddle a bar anchored at one end and row the loaded end to the chest.
uncertain_note: No T-bar/landmine item in the equipment list; mapped to barbell. Lats vs mid-back is approximate.

name: Seated cable row
notes: Seated at a low cable, pull the handle to the stomach with the chest tall and squeeze the shoulder blades together.

name: Wide-grip seated cable row
notes: Cable row with a wide bar, elbows flaring out to bias the upper back.
uncertain_note: Primary muscle (mid traps vs lats) is approximate.

name: Machine row
notes: Chest-supported row on a plate-loaded or selectorised row machine.

name: Single-arm dumbbell row
notes: With one hand and knee on a bench, row a dumbbell to the hip.

name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
notes: Lying chest-down on an incline bench, row a dumbbell in each hand toward the ribs.
uncertain_note: Primary muscle (mid traps vs lats) depends on elbow angle.

name: Single-arm cable row
notes: Seated or standing, row one cable handle to the side of the torso.

name: Inverted row
notes: Hang under a fixed bar with the body straight and pull the chest up to the bar.
uncertain_note: Needs a low bar or rack; no matching equipment item, so mapped to bodyweight.

name: Resistance band row
notes: Seated or standing, pull an anchored band toward the stomach.

name: Dumbbell pullover
notes: Lying across or along a bench, move one dumbbell in an arc from over the chest to behind the head and back.
uncertain_note: Lat vs chest emphasis is debated; categorised as isolation.

name: Barbell shrug
notes: Holding a bar at the thighs, lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears and lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell shrug
notes: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at the sides and shrug the shoulders upward.

name: Face pull
notes: Pull a rope attachment from a high cable toward the face, hands splitting apart at the end.
uncertain_note: Often called a compound pull; categorised as isolation for rear delts.

name: Band pull-apart
notes: Hold a band in front at shoulder height and pull it apart until it touches the chest.

name: Rack pull
notes: Deadlift from pins set around knee height, focusing on the upper back and lockout.
uncertain_note: Primary muscle (erectors vs glutes vs traps) is approximate.

name: Back extension
notes: On a hyperextension bench, hinge at the hips to lower the torso then raise it back to straight.
uncertain_note: Normally done on a back-extension bench, which is not in the equipment list; mapped to bodyweight.

name: Superman
notes: Lying face-down, lift the arms and legs off the floor together and hold briefly.

name: Overhead press
notes: Standing, press a barbell from the collarbone to overhead with the ribs down and glutes tight.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
notes: Seated or standing, press two dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead.

name: Arnold press
notes: Dumbbell press that starts with palms facing you and rotates to palms forward as the weights rise.

name: Machine shoulder press
notes: Seated overhead press on a guided machine.

name: Smith machine shoulder press
notes: Seated press on the Smith machine, bar lowered to chin level.

name: Kettlebell press
notes: Press a kettlebell from the rack position at the shoulder to overhead with the wrist stacked.

name: Pike push-ups
notes: From a hips-high push-up position, bend the elbows to bring the head toward the floor and press back up.

name: Lateral raise
notes: Standing with dumbbells at the sides, raise the arms out to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.

name: Cable lateral raise
notes: Raise one arm out to the side against a low cable for constant tension.

name: Resistance band lateral raise
notes: Stand on a band and raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height.

name: Front raise
notes: Raise dumbbells in front of the body to shoulder height with straight-ish arms.

name: Cable front raise
notes: Facing away from a low cable, raise the handle forward to shoulder height.

name: Reverse dumbbell fly
notes: Hinged forward, raise dumbbells out to the sides to work the rear shoulders.

name: Reverse pec deck fly
notes: Facing the pad on a pec deck, pull the handles backward and out.

name: Cable rear delt fly
notes: With crossed cables at chest height, pull each handle out and back in an arc.

name: Resistance band face pull
notes: Pull an anchored band toward the face with the elbows high.

name: Upright row
notes: Pull a bar up the front of the body to chest height, elbows leading.
uncertain_note: Some lifters find this uncomfortable for the shoulders; muscle split is approximate.

name: Barbell curl
notes: Standing, curl a straight bar up with the elbows pinned to the sides.

name: EZ-bar curl
notes: Curl with an EZ bar, which angles the wrists for comfort.

name: Dumbbell curl
notes: Curl dumbbells with the palms turning up as the weights rise.

name: Hammer curl
notes: Curl dumbbells with the palms facing each other throughout.
uncertain_note: Brachialis chosen as primary; biceps and brachioradialis share the work.

name: Preacher curl
notes: Curl an EZ bar with the upper arms resting on an angled pad.

name: Dumbbell preacher curl
notes: One-arm curl with the upper arm supported on a preacher pad.

name: Incline dumbbell curl
notes: Curl with the back on an inclined bench so the arms hang behind the body for a longer stretch.

name: Concentration curl
notes: Seated, brace the elbow against the inner thigh and curl a single dumbbell.

name: Cable curl
notes: Curl a straight or EZ attachment from a low pulley for steady tension.

name: Cable rope hammer curl
notes: Curl a rope attachment from a low pulley with the thumbs up.

name: Reverse curl
notes: Curl an EZ bar with an overhand grip to load the forearms and brachialis.
uncertain_note: Forearms (brachioradialis) chosen as primary.

name: Resistance band curl
notes: Stand on a band and curl the handles toward the shoulders.

name: Cable triceps pushdown
notes: Facing a high pulley, press a bar down until the arms are straight, keeping the elbows at the sides.
uncertain_note: Head emphasis between the three triceps heads is approximate.

name: Rope triceps pushdown
notes: Pushdown with a rope, spreading the ends apart at the bottom.

name: Reverse-grip triceps pushdown
notes: Pushdown with an underhand grip, which shifts load toward the medial head.
uncertain_note: Head emphasis is approximate.

name: Overhead triceps extension
notes: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands and bend the elbows to lower it behind the head.

name: Cable overhead triceps extension
notes: Facing away from a pulley, extend the arms overhead against the cable.

name: Skull crushers
notes: Lying on a bench, lower an EZ bar toward the forehead by bending only the elbows, then extend.

name: Close-grip bench press
notes: Bench press with the hands about shoulder-width apart to shift work to the triceps.
uncertain_note: Triceps vs chest primary is a judgement call.

name: Bench dips
notes: With hands on a bench behind you, lower the hips by bending the elbows, then press up.

name: Triceps dips
notes: On parallel bars with an upright torso, lower and press up to emphasise the triceps.

name: Diamond push-ups
notes: Push-up with the hands close together under the chest.

name: Triceps kickback
notes: Hinged forward with the upper arm parallel to the floor, straighten the elbow to extend the dumbbell back.

name: Resistance band triceps pushdown
notes: Anchor a band high and press it down until the elbows are straight.

name: Barbell wrist curl
notes: Forearms resting on a bench, curl the bar upward using only the wrists.

name: Reverse wrist curl
notes: Forearms resting on a bench palms down, lift the dumbbell with the back of the wrist.

name: Farmer's carry
notes: Walk with a heavy dumbbell in each hand, standing tall and keeping the shoulders level.
uncertain_note: Whole-body carry; forearms chosen as primary for grip work.

name: Dead hang
notes: Hang from a bar with a firm grip for time to build grip endurance.

name: Barbell squat
notes: Bar across the upper back, squat until the thighs are at least parallel, then stand.
uncertain_note: Squat rack not captured because an exercise has one equipment item.

name: Front squat
notes: Bar racked on the front shoulders, squat with an upright torso.

name: Goblet squat
notes: Hold one dumbbell against the chest and squat between the knees.

name: Smith machine squat
notes: Squat on the Smith machine with the feet slightly forward of the bar.

name: Bodyweight squat
notes: Squat to depth with no load, arms forward for balance.

name: Leg press
notes: Seated, press the platform away with both feet and lower under control.

name: Leg extension
notes: Seated machine movement straightening the knees against a pad.

name: Bulgarian split squat
notes: Rear foot on a bench, lower the front knee toward the floor holding dumbbells.

name: Walking lunges
notes: Step forward into a lunge and alternate legs, travelling across the floor.

name: Reverse lunge
notes: Step backward into a lunge and return to standing, alternating legs.
uncertain_note: Quads vs glutes primary is a judgement call.

name: Step-ups
notes: Step onto a box or bench with one leg and stand tall, holding dumbbells.

name: Sumo squat
notes: Wide stance with the toes out, hold a dumbbell between the legs and squat.

name: Sissy squat
notes: Lean back while bending the knees forward over the toes to isolate the quads.

name: Romanian deadlift
notes: Hinge at the hips with a soft knee bend, lowering the bar down the thighs, then drive the hips forward.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
notes: Romanian deadlift with a dumbbell in each hand.

name: Stiff-leg deadlift
notes: Hip hinge with nearly straight legs, stretching the hamstrings at the bottom.

name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
notes: Balance on one leg and hinge forward while the other leg lifts behind.

name: Conventional deadlift
notes: Lift a bar from the floor to a standing lockout with a flat back and hips and knees extending together.
uncertain_note: Prime mover is shared by glutes, hamstrings and erectors; glutes chosen as primary.

name: Sumo deadlift
notes: Deadlift with a wide stance and hands inside the knees.
uncertain_note: Primary muscle is approximate.

name: Kettlebell deadlift
notes: Hip hinge to lift a kettlebell from the floor between the feet.

name: Kettlebell swing
notes: Hinge and snap the hips forward to swing a kettlebell to chest height.

name: Barbell hip thrust
notes: Upper back on a bench, drive the hips up with a barbell across them until the body is straight.

name: Glute bridge
notes: Lying on the back with knees bent, lift the hips and squeeze the glutes at the top.

name: Cable pull-through
notes: Facing away from a low cable, hinge and thrust the hips forward against the rope.

name: Cable glute kickback
notes: With an ankle strap on a low pulley, extend the leg behind you.

name: Lying leg curl
notes: Face-down on the machine, curl the heels toward the glutes.

name: Seated leg curl
notes: Seated version of the leg curl with the pad above the heels.

name: Nordic hamstring curl
notes: Kneeling with the ankles anchored, lower the torso forward slowly using the hamstrings.
uncertain_note: Needs a partner or anchor; no matching equipment item.

name: Banded lateral walk
notes: With a band around the legs and knees slightly bent, step sideways keeping tension.

name: Cable hip abduction
notes: With an ankle strap on a low pulley, lift the leg out to the side.

name: Cable hip adduction
notes: With an ankle strap on a low pulley, pull the leg across the body.

name: Standing calf raise
notes: Rise onto the toes against the machine pads and lower the heels below the platform.

name: Seated calf raise
notes: Seated with the knees bent, raise the heels against the pad.
uncertain_note: Seated variants bias the soleus; the muscle list has a single calves entry.

name: Leg press calf raise
notes: On the leg press, push the platform with the balls of the feet and flex the ankles.

name: Single-leg dumbbell calf raise
notes: On a step with a dumbbell in one hand, raise and lower on one foot.

name: Bodyweight calf raise
notes: Rise onto the toes and lower slowly, optionally from the edge of a step.

name: Crunches
notes: Lying on the back with knees bent, curl the ribs toward the pelvis.

name: Weighted crunches
notes: Crunch while holding a dumbbell against the chest.

name: Cable crunch
notes: Kneeling at a high pulley, curl the torso down so the elbows move toward the knees.

name: Reverse crunches
notes: Lying on the back, curl the hips off the floor by bringing the knees toward the chest.

name: Hanging leg raise
notes: Hang from a bar and raise straight legs toward it without swinging.

name: Hanging knee raise
notes: Hang from a bar and raise the bent knees to hip height or higher.

name: Lying leg raise
notes: Lying flat, raise straight legs to vertical and lower them with control.

name: Plank
notes: Hold a straight line from head to heels on the forearms and toes.
uncertain_note: Isometric; primary muscle (deep core vs rectus) is a judgement call.

name: Side plank
notes: Hold a straight line from head to feet on one forearm, body side-on.

name: Russian twists
notes: Seated and leaning back, rotate the torso from side to side.

name: Bicycle crunch
notes: Lying down, alternate bringing opposite elbow and knee together in a pedalling motion.

name: Cable woodchopper
notes: Rotate the torso to pull a cable diagonally across the body from high to low.

name: Pallof press
notes: Standing side-on to a cable, press the handle forward and resist the pull to rotate.

name: Dumbbell side bend
notes: Hold a dumbbell at one side and bend sideways at the waist, then return upright.

name: Dead bug
notes: Lying on the back, extend opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back flat.

name: Barbell rollout
notes: Kneeling, roll a loaded barbell forward and back, keeping the hips from sagging.
uncertain_note: Usually done with an ab wheel, which is not in the equipment list.
